heading_en: Submission of an Application for Approval
summary_ja: シナリオ法の承認を受けようとする最終指定親会社が提出する承認申請書の記載事項と添付書類を定める。
summary_en: Specifies the contents of, and documents to be attached to, the application for approval of the scenario method.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company seeking the approval under the preceding Article for the use of the scenario method shall submit to the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency an application for approval stating the following matters: (i) trade name; (ii) the name and title of the person responsible for ascertaining and managing the Consolidated Capital Adequacy Ratio.

The following documents shall be attached to the application for approval under the preceding paragraph: (i) a statement of reasons; (ii) a curriculum vitae of the person responsible prescribed in item (ii) of the preceding paragraph; (iii) documents showing that the operation of the scenario method conforms to the approval standards; (iv) other documents stating matters that would serve as reference.
